description: Source code for JSON parsing utilities, including functions for selecting JSON objects, extracting values, and handling JSON arrays.

methods.name: dmjson_select_obj
methods.description: Selects a nested JSON object based on a list of keys.

methods.name: dmjson_print_value
methods.description: Converts a JSON object to its string representation based on its type.

methods.name: ____dmjson_get_value_in_obj
methods.description: Retrieves the string value of a nested JSON object based on a list of keys.

methods.name: __dmjson_get_value_in_obj
methods.description: Public interface to get a value in a JSON object given argument count and list of keys.

methods.name: __dmjson_get_obj
methods.description: Retrieves a nested JSON object based on a list of keys.

methods.name: ____dmjson_select_obj_in_array_idx
methods.description: Selects a JSON object within an array at a specified index, possibly nested.

methods.name: __dmjson_select_obj_in_array_idx
methods.description: Retrieves a JSON object within an array at a specified index, with variable arguments for nested keys.

methods.name: ____dmjson_get_value_in_array_idx
methods.description: Gets the string value of a JSON object within an array at a specified index.

methods.name: __dmjson_get_value_in_array_idx
methods.description: Public interface to get a string value from a JSON array element at a specific index with fallback.

methods.name: ____dmjson_get_value_array_all
methods.description: Concatenates values from multiple JSON array elements into a single string separated by delimiters.

methods.name: __dmjson_get_value_array_all
methods.description: Public interface to get concatenated string of multiple JSON array elements.
